11016.title: Key Largo
11016.overview: A hurricane swells outside, but it's nothing compared to the storm within the hotel at Key Largo. There, sadistic mobster Johnny Rocco holes up - and holds at gunpoint hotel owner James Temple, his widowed daughter-in-law Nora, and ex-GI Frank McCloud.

123656.title: La P’tite Lili
123656.overview: La P’tite Lili is a silent short drama depicting the fate of a young orphaned girl in the working-class districts of Paris. The film follows Lili, a teenage girl marked by innocence and vulnerability, as she is drawn into the city’s underworld after encountering a man who exploits her circumstances. Told through impressionistic visual style rather than dialogue, the film presents a tragic portrait of social marginalization and moral collapse within an urban environment.

199432.title: Song of the Sea
199432.overview: In the drought areas of Northeastern of Brazil, groups of migrants move trying to find better place to live, at least with water. Some of them go to Recife, to get a vessel to Santos expecting to have a better life in the Southern. In the poor area of Recife, an old washerwoman launders clothes to survive and support her family. Her husband Zé Luis, a former sailor, is crazy due to a hit of the boom of a mast on his head. Her older son Raimundo works in a grocery and selling mangoes on the street, trying to save money to move to the Southeastern with his girl-friend Aurora. Her daughter wants to be a prostitute to have a better quality of life. Her younger son is seriously sick.

300168.title: Dragon Blade
300168.overview: Huo An, the commander of the Protection Squad of the Western Regions, was framed by evil forces and becomes enslaved. On the other hand, a Roman general escapes to China after rescuing the Prince. The heroic duo meet in the Western Desert and a thrilling story unfolds.
300168.trailerName: Dragon Blade (2015 Movie – Jackie Chan, John Cusack, Adrien Brody) – Official Trailer

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

356616.title: O Tigre e a Gazela
356616.overview: The faces, the gestures and speech of beggars, madmen and revelers passing through the streets of São Paulo. The sounds and images are illustrated with Frantz Fanon extracts.

487560.title: Last Friday
487560.overview: The fourth and final installment in the 'Friday' franchise.

803208.title: Orphan
803208.overview: A young boy after the Hungarian uprising of 1956, raised by his mother with the tale of an idealized dead father, has his world turned upside down when a brutish man appears, claiming to be his true parent.

972232.title: K-Pops!
972232.overview: A washed-up musician travels to Korea to write for K-pop stars, discovering that his long-lost son is set to front one of the country’s hottest new groups. He then jumps at the opportunity to capitalize on his son’s stardom for his own renaissance, but learns that fatherhood is much more fulfilling and meaningful than stardom.

1092936.title: The Holy Boy
1092936.overview: A PE teacher moves to a isolated mountain village where the people appear to live in unshakeable serenity, but soon stumbles across a disturbing ritual. Once a week, the locals are freed of their pain by a lonely boy born with the power to heal one's soul just by hugging them. Trying to rescue him from this madness, the man unleashes his dark side.

1198984.title: We Bury the Dead
1198984.overview: After a catastrophic military disaster, the dead don't just rise - they hunt. Ava searches for her missing husband, but what she finds is far more terrifying.
1198984.trailerName: We Bury the Dead | 2025 | @SignatureUK Trailer | Daisy Ridley Zombie Horror Thriller

1204680.title: Coyote vs. Acme
1204680.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

1217928.title: Bad Day at the Office
1217928.overview: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.
1217928.trailerName: 'BAD DAY AT THE OFFICE' Teaser Trailer (2026) | POV Action Thriller | John Hannah | Tamer Hassan

1231624.title: He Loves Me Not
1231624.overview: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.
1231624.trailerName: He Loves Me Not - Official Trailer

1281096.title: Labrador — Autopsy of Silence
1281096.overview: A cargo ship embarks on its final voyage of the year to resupply Inuit communities in the far north of Canada. During a storm off the coast of Labrador, the ship’s cook is found murdered in his cabin. With no way to identify the culprit among the twenty crew members, suspicion falls on Alupa, an Inuit mechanic and close friend of the victim.  Unfolding in reverse, from the investigation back to the night of the storm and the murder, the film transcends the boundaries of a traditional whodunit to probe deeper questions of race, class, and sexual desire.

1282440.title: Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos
1282440.overview: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

1288328.title: The Illusion
1288328.overview: 1860. Giuseppe Garibaldi began from Quarto the adventure of the Thousand surrounded by the enthusiasm of the young idealists who had come from all regions of Italy, and with his loyal group of officers, among whom a new profile stands out. Having landed in Sicily, at Marsala, the Thousand begin fighting with the Bourbon army, whose numerical preponderance is immediately evident. Under these conditions, it appears almost impossible for the general to breach the enemy defense and penetrate Palermo. But when he is almost forced to retreat, Garibaldi devises an ingenious plan.

1290568.title: Margie Claus
1290568.overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

1304776.title: Estrelando Marta
1304776.overview: Marta dreams of starting her acting career.

1305672.title: I Know Who You Are
1305672.overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.
1305672.trailerName: I KNOW WHO YOU ARE | ANZ TRAILER | 09 JULY

1317448.title: No Place to Be Single
1317448.overview: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

1320392.title: One to One: John & Yoko
1320392.overview: An exploration of the seminal and transformative 18 months that one of music’s most famous couples — John Lennon and Yoko Ono — spent living in Greenwich Village, New York City, in the early 1970s.

1327688.title: One Mile: Chapter One
1327688.overview: After being released from prison, a father tries to reconnect with his daughter by taking her on a tour of college, but they soon find themselves fighting for more than their lost relationship when a murderous cult pursues them.

1329864.title: On the Wings of a Butterfly
1329864.overview: Go Ara, a deaf dancer, navigates a world where hearing aids offer only a partial connection to sound. The nuances of speech remain beyond her grasp, and the music that fuels her dancing feels frustratingly distant. Despite these obstacles, Go Ara embarks on a profound journey: motherhood. Haunted by childhood taunts in music class, she hasn't sung in twenty years. Yet, the birth of her child awakens a long-dormant desire. For the first time in two decades, Go Ara sings a lullaby. This simple act reignites her love for music, prompting her to explore new artistic territories and craft a soundscape that is uniquely her own.

1336968.title: Neon Banana
1336968.overview: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

1364168.title: Lily's Ritual
1364168.overview: Four friends travel to an isolated house to perform a witchcraft ritual.

1371144.title: Paper Cuts
1371144.overview: A deeper look into Switzerland's counterfeits during WWII.

1393096.title: The Yeast
1393096.overview: Eighteen-year-old Da-seul was spending an ordinary life helping her father run a traditional makgeolli (rice wine) brewery. However, because the origin of the 'nuruk' (the yeast) that determines the taste of the makgeolli was unknown, their makgeolli could not be officially distributed, and they ended up secretly selling it only to the local villagers. Her older brother, Da-hyeon, who wanted to modernize the brewery, secretly threw away the old nuruk and replaced it with a commercially available one without telling their father or Da-seul. He thought no one would notice—but from that day on, Da-seul fell ill as if possessed, saying "the nuruk is gone." At first, Da-hyeon found it absurd, but as Da-seul's condition worsened, he began to take it seriously. He eventually discovers traces of the nuruk in an unexpected place, and through a chaotic episode involving homeless people, Da-seul and Da-hyeon come to face a truth they had long turned away from.

1407432.title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
1407432.overview: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.
1407432.trailerName: Anaganaga Oka Raju | Official Trailer | Naveen Polishetty, Meenakshi Chaudhary | Netflix India

1417480.title: Mother's Home
1417480.overview: On Christmas Eve, a teenager has an orgasm while dreaming of his mother. The next day, he has to face her with this idea in mind.

1421128.title: Shadowbox
1421128.overview: Maya discovers that her husband – an ex-soldier who is suffering from PTSD - is the prime suspect in a murder investigation. She and her teenage son are forced to go to extremes to keep the family together.

1436168.title: Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone
1436168.overview: Romi has been living happily ever since Heartsping became her best friend. But she and her mother, Belita, keep clashing over what Romi wants to do versus what she's told she must do... Then one day, an event that shakes the entire sea sweeps her mother away without a trace. Romi loses her mother without ever getting to say sorry — without one last hug. Standing before the sea for the very first time, she finds the courage to act, together with her best friend Heartsping, the sea boy Kite, and three Teeniepings... Together, they must face a dazzling underwater city and colossal creatures of the deep. And at last, Romi comes face to face with a secret her mother had never once told her.

1444424.title: Dogwood
1444424.overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

1452168.title: Behemoth!
1452168.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

1465544.title: State of Firsts
1465544.overview: A documentary that follows Sarah McBride’s groundbreaking first year in Congress as the first openly transgender person elected to the U.S. legislature, State of Firsts captures her battle against relentless political attacks. As MAGA Republicans ban her from restrooms and publicly misgender her, McBride confronts threats and discrimination with resilience. Focused on meaningful policy work over partisan conflict, she draws inspiration from historical figures who overcame adversity, offering a powerful look at perseverance in the face of systemic opposition.

1472776.title: Aphrodites
1472776.overview: A group of sisters is accused of inciting lust during a typhus epidemic. Nurse Aurora investigates, facing prevailing superstition.

1477576.title: Love, After All
1477576.overview: The everyday life of a married couple at a turning point: Lore wants a divorce—after almost 40 years of marriage.

1497480.title: Ish
1497480.overview: Twelve-year-old best friends, Ish and Maram wrestle to hold onto their friendship, in the wake of a traumatic police stop & search. As the ripples take hold, the boys try to make sense of the men they are becoming – and how ‘letting go’ can be the hardest part of growing up.

1506696.title: Duckweed
1506696.overview: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

1507336.title: Haute solitude
1507336.overview: This film immerses us in the life of a famous prisoner, Jean Zay, who was held for four years because of his political beliefs and the violently antisemitic climate, in Clermont-Ferrand, Marseille, and then Riom. The Minister of National Education and Fine Arts under the Popular Front was assassinated by the Vichy militia on June 20, 1944.

1508168.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
1508168.overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

1509512.title: The Pickleball Racket
1509512.overview: Disgraced councilwoman of Busterville, Ethel Wilton, finds herself at the center of a pickleball conspiracy. She decides the only way to save her city is to stop the citywide pickleball tournament with the help of her unlikely friends.

1514056.title: Nika & Madison
1514056.overview: Fearing they won't be believed, two young Indigenous women go on the run after one's defense of the other results in a violent attack against a police officer.

1517064.title: Funeral Casino Blues
1517064.overview: Jen lives in Bangkok – between the reception desk of an apartment building and the hotel rooms of strange men. What she sells is time, intimacy, sometimes just a moment. When a meeting escalates, Wason intervenes – a bartender who has lost more than he lets on.

1521352.title: Sai: Disaster
1521352.overview: Four people lead ordinary lives in different places, their paths never crossing. A mysterious man appears in each story, always as someone else. One moment, a cram school instructor; the next, a truck driver, a barber - his identity constantly shifting. Then, death strikes. A detective pursues the truth, closing in on a revelation...
1521352.trailerName: BIFF2025 Trailer | 재앙 재 SAI: disaster | 아시아영화의 창

1532808.title: Five Years, Four Months
1532808.overview: Martha (45), a mother who lost track of her son due to the conflict, receives the news that there was no bone concordance in the last exhumation she participated in. Exhausted of the institutional channels, she turns to a group of women searchers and meets Sandra, who tells her a rumor: “in a remote village on the flatlands of Colombia, you can request a favour from a dead person”. Together with Sandra, they embark on a journey in search of answers, blurring the line between the living and the dead. Mothers searching for their children, children searching for their mothers: two sides of the same scourge converge in search of peace.

1535944.title: Leave the Cat Alone
1535944.overview: Mori, a musician struggling with the distance between himself and his wife Maiko, a photographer, has an unexpected reunion with his former friend Asako. This encounter rekindles a love that had long since passed between them. However, their memories diverge, and recollections colored by expectations and desires emerge blurred, distorted, and conveniently rewritten within each of them. And at the end of a long walk, Mori and Asako come to reexamine their two lives that have already strayed from their paths, and the present moment where each of them now stands.

1536008.title: Confessions of a Shaman
1536008.overview: A man who decides to inherit the art of shamanism to exact personal revenge, leading to a series of terrifying events that change his life forever.
1536008.trailerName: FINAL TRAILER “Confessions of a Shaman” | OFFICIAL TRAILER
1536008.original_title: คำสารภาพของหมอผี

1541128.title: Office of Magical Forces
1541128.overview: 11-year-old Yurko and Mia accidentally stumble upon a mysterious entrance to Otherworldly Kyiv, which has existed since 482. Funny mystical characters come to life in the center of a modern metropolis, and the main characters find themselves in the midst of magical adventures.

1549128.title: Twin Stars
1549128.overview: The story, set in a rural place, tells in a comic way the difference between the slow pace of the province and the frenetic pace of the capital.

1553672.title: Das gewisse Etwas
1553672.overview: After a jewelry heist, a father and son are on the run from the police. They find refuge in a coach full of people with disabilities who are on their way to a holiday camp in the Alpine foothills with their carer. Without further ado, they pretend to be a missing fellow passenger and his carer.

1556616.title: Summer House
1556616.overview: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

1559624.title: In Case We Never Meet Again
1559624.overview: Amid the war in Ukraine, Tanya and Zenit’s fragile love story unfolds, stretched between moments of closeness and conflict. Meanwhile, a group of children play war, building block posts, and imagining futures defined by violence.

1560520.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
1560520.overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

1563912.title: How to Find a Career That Loves You Back
1563912.overview: Khloe and Joyce, two trans women who work for a defense-technology corporation, fall in love when they're sent to a college career fair together. Their fragile bond forces Khloe to choose between safety and the uncertain path of freedom.
1563912.original_title: How to Find a Career That Loves You Back

1566920.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Deceased Empress' Treasure
1566920.overview: The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.
1566920.original_title: 劇場版 薬屋のひとりごと 亡妃の秘宝

1567560.title: Wood Street
1567560.overview: Two unhoused men turned community leaders— John and LaMonté —organize their neighbors in the face of displacement, addiction, and a failing social system.

1567688.title: Elon Musk Unveiled – The Tesla Experiment
1567688.overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

1571400.title: Neural Command
1571400.overview: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.

1585736.title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
1585736.overview: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

1589640.title: The Serpent Spirit Goddess
1589640.overview: Dedi, a man who is bankrupt and deep in debt, performs a ritual to marry a beautiful jinn named Dewi in order to get the money to pay off his debts—with one condition: he must never marry anyone else.  As Dedi grows richer and more prosperous, he suddenly falls in love with a woman and intends to marry her. Dewi becomes furious because Dedi has forgotten the condition of the ritual, and eventually, a series of terrifying events threatens the lives of those closest to Dedi.

1595400.title: Matched: True Love
1595400.overview: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.
1595400.trailerName: 映画『マッチング TRUE LOVE』特報映像【2026年秋全国公開】

1596168.title: A Tribe Called Love
1596168.overview: Set in a Somali neighbourhood in Toronto, teenagers Farah and Halima as they fall in love despite warnings to stay apart because they’re from different tribes. When Farah’s family relocates to Vancouver, the relationship ends abruptly — until they reconnect in their twenties in Toronto. But the same cultural barriers that once divided them soon resurface. Will their love be strong enough to rewrite their fate, or are some histories destined to repeat themselves?

1596296.title: The History of Concrete
1596296.overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

1603464.title: Lads Being Lads
1603464.overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

1603656.title: Bike Ambulance Dada
1603656.overview: Based on the life of Padma Shri Karimul Haque. The world's first bike ambulance man who has saved over 7,000 lives.

1611912.title: NAXOS
1611912.overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

1620040.title: My Brother's Killer
1620040.overview: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

1620872.title: Giaffa The Great
1620872.overview: Giacomo Falta is a man ignored by everyone, unable to find his place in the world. When he meets the charismatic Giason the Great, the man who embodies everything he has always wanted to be, he makes a dangerous decision, convinced that putting on a different face is all he needs to do to finally be seen. Thus begins a long night, in which the boundary between identity and illusion grows increasingly blurred, to the point where Giacomo's very existence is put at risk.

1620936.title: The Great Experiment
1620936.overview: The Great Experiment is an ambitious cinematic time capsule of one of the most volatile and perplexing eras of American history; a project that serves as a historical document, non-fiction experiment and intimate observation of the changing state of American democracy and identity. A surprising time capsule of a nation grappling with its differences and diversity, and our experience and perceptions of conflict, survival and belonging.

1623944.title: Applause
1623944.overview: Two teenagers encounter a rock that gives them the power to switch places with the clap of their hands. However, one of the boys struggles with bullying, relationship issues, and sexual identity as he tries to navigate the world as a young adolescent.

1631816.title: As We Burn
1631816.overview: It begins at the margins of power: a few teenagers protest outside parliament, cardboard signs in hand and an unyielding determination in their eyes. From there, Helena Molin’s long-term portrait unfolds—of a generation forced early on to confront the ruthlessness of politics. Their fight for the climate and for justice runs parallel to a life that should be about friendship, play, and future dreams, but is repeatedly interrupted by the failures of the adult world. The result is an intimate and powerful depiction of what happens when moral responsibility is placed in the hands of those still searching for their place in the world.

1632136.title: SYNTHETICA
1632136.overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

1632584.title: A CNN & Variety Town Hall Event: Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey
1632584.overview: Filmed before a live audience of students at The University of Texas at Austin's Moody College of Communication, this event brings together two of Hollywood's most dynamic actors, Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey, for a candid discussion about their craft and creative process. In addition to reflecting on their approaches to performance and the roles that have most influenced their artistic journeys, Chalamet and McConaughey will also take questions from the student audience throughout the program.

1634504.title: Streaming Killed the Video Store*
1634504.overview: An employee is stalked in a video store

1638280.title: Derek vs Derek
1638280.overview: The idyllic English countryside. An intensive dairy farmer called Derek. One day his neighbour, also called Derek, forsakes farming tradition and starts to turn his land over to wild nature. How does the community react when one of it’s own turns his back on their way of life?

1642568.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
1642568.overview: Working as a CIA field agent, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

1654856.title: What is dyslexia?
1654856.overview: Before you read anything from searching the internet, discover the extraordinary potential of your dyslexic mind.

1661000.title: 7 Days 7 People
1661000.overview: The story of Jinhwa, an indie musician at a crossroads of life, agonizing between ideals and reality as he meets seven close people around him for seven days.

1663816.title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 1
1663816.overview: The opening night of New Japan Pro Wrestling's annual junior heavyweight round-robin tournament took place on May 14, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

1665224.title: Sheng Wang: Purple
1665224.overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.
1665224.trailerName: Sheng Wang: Purple | Official Trailer | Netflix

1666888.title: My Little Blue Heart
1666888.overview: In a near future in rural Britain, Mustafa and his deaf sister Amna are torn apart by immigration vigilantes and their far-right policies. Amna escapes to search for her brother, only to witness a tragic event.

1673928.title: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior
1673928.overview: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.

1674248.title: Trinity: The Story of The LOX
1674248.overview: Travel through time and reflect on the genesis, journey, and brotherhood of the multidimensional rap trio from Yonkers, The LOX.

1679176.title: Carbon Counters
1679176.overview: The science of carbon counting is becoming a quintessential knowledge practice that characterizes the age of the climate crisis. From the carbon footprint information on a soda can to the international treaties on carbon credits, we count carbon to design and orient our climate policies. Knowing the accurate amount of carbon emission and absorption, however, is not as easy as it might sound, since counting carbon is heavily affected by contrasting methodologies, competing economic interests, and conflicting cultural standards. The carbon numbers, like all important numbers, are scientific and political at the same time.

1680072.title: The Narcissist's Playbook
1680072.overview: Five-country documentary with four self-aware malignant narcissists exposing their manipulation methods, victim accounts, and expert analysis of narcissistic abuse patterns to help viewers identify and defend against such behavior.

1685768.title: The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man
1685768.overview: What if Spider-Man’s most important mission wasn’t saving the city? In The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man, Spider-Man meets his biggest fan, Tim—a kid who’s collected everything about him, from his first appearance to every battle he’s ever fought. What starts as a dream come true quickly becomes something deeper as Tim begins asking real questions about power, responsibility, and what it means to be a hero, forcing Peter to open up in ways he never has before. But as the night goes on, Spider-Man realizes this isn’t just a visit—it’s a moment that matters more than anything he’s done in the suit, proving that being a hero isn’t about fighting villains or saving the world, but about showing up for someone when they need it most.

1688392.title: Guardians of the Video Game
1688392.overview: Falling from cutting-edge 3D games into a forgotten pixel RPG, an exiled guardian of the gaming world must secretly guide an innocent hero to the ending, uncover the conspiracy out to destroy him and the game itself.

1688584.title: Ghost of Ueno
1688584.overview: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident.
